purpose: Closure-ready ownership accounting; this document is not a final gate result.

historical_unanchored_accounting.meaning: These are the 74 inputs from the earlier unanchored-input census; the current partial manifest reports 72 unanchored inputs.

evidence_classes.direct-local: Surviving ELF LOCAL owner evidence; strongest ownership evidence.
evidence_classes.name-policy: Filename/prefix or attributed-symbol policy candidate; not proof of original TU ownership.
evidence_classes.unidentified: Available evidence does not identify the original owner; this is not a claim that ownership is impossible.

current_disposition_summary: 40 lowercase fax wrappers are retained in eight canonical RX/TX files as naming-policy dispositions.
46 uppercase fax API definitions remain in the four aggregate files after co-location lost period exactness; original owners are not proven by family names.
Four SMCv17 functions and smc_ring_advance are retained in Smc.c as a naming-policy candidate, without raw LOCAL proof; V17 tables remain in v17.c.
VPcmFloModemCtor constructor and LOCAL-backed tables are merged into VpcmFloModem.cpp.
Mixed V22 direct-LOCAL ownership decisions are recorded as resolved.
